Episodes: joined E148 (the Finnish takeover of the Bears logo); new E825 minnesotavikings (the truce and the joint 4, ten members in both), E826 chibears (the rivals' attacks, two members in both). One-sided: nascar names the room's April Fools as better; greenlattice holds no Packers code; texans names the room only. Leads: kingdomhearts, monero, TheFarLeftSide, suomi (unread)
